title: Proof page heading
guidance: Use a readable job identity and page title rather than a tiny uppercase eyebrow. Place status with its related heading. Remove the obvious Share evidence description.
Anchor the job status at the upper right of its heading region, consistently with other job/entity cards. Preserve readable job identity and enlarged-text reflow.

decisions.title: Status follows the shared heading grid
decisions.reason: Identity/title left and lifecycle status upper-right, with a full-width title row when narrow enlarged text needs it. See Entity status heading.

decisions.title: Task and job identity have distinct weights
decisions.reason: Proof of delivery is the page title with lifecycle status in the shared upper-right slot. Job #ID and name follow in readable sentence case.

decisions.title: Remove obvious page description
decisions.reason: Share evidence the creator can review repeats the task. The title/status/job identity provide the context.

parameters.name: Shared heading grid
parameters.description: The title/status region consumes .cu-status-heading: minmax(0,1fr) and auto columns, 1rem column and .75rem row gaps. Narrow enlarged text gives identity its full row beneath an upper-right badge. Story CSS owns the readable job identity and quiet separator.
